The '''1897 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship Final''' was the 10th All-Ireland Final and the culmination of the [[1897 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship]], an inter-county [[hurling]] tournament for the top teams in [[Ireland]]. The match was held at the [[Tipperary GAA Field]], on 20 November 1898 between [[Kilkenny GAA|Kilkenny]], represented by club side [[Tullaroan GAA|Tullaroan]], and [[Limerick GAA|Limerick]], represented by club side [[Kilfinane GAA|Kilfinane]]. The Leinster champions lost to their Munster opponents on a score line of 3–4 to 2–4.<ref>{{cite book |last=Bellew |first=Ronnie |last2=Crowe |first2=Dermot |date=2014 |title=Hell for Leather: A Journey Through Hurling in 100 Games |url=https://www.google.com/books/edition/Hell_for_Leather/wjfuBQAAQBAJ |publisher=[[Hachette Books]] |isbn=9781444789928 |access-date=May 20, 2025}}</ref>
